lines.en: label dojo30:
scene ayanetoukadojo1
Ayane and I are resting for a bit after actually spending the afternoon training.
lines.zh: 在真的练了一下午之后，我和 Ayane 正坐着休息一会儿。

lines.en: Given that we’ve been spending most of our recent days messing around and playing with her chicken (Which is apparently not allowed in the dojo), we figured it was about time to actually try.
lines.zh: 考虑到最近我们大多时候都在胡闹、玩她那只鸡（显然这在道场里是不允许的），我们觉得差不多该真的练一练了。

lines.en: That and the instructor has been getting on our case about taking things seriously or we’ll be removed from the class.
lines.zh: 再加上教练一直在念叨，说再不认真点就要把我们踢出这个班。

lines.en: To be honest, I wouldn’t mind being kicked out since it would mean less time physically exerting myself...but Ayane likely would, so I’ve been bearing with it for her sake.
lines.zh: 说实话，被踢出去我倒无所谓，因为那样我就不用花那么多时间消耗体力了……可 Ayane 大概会在意，所以看在她的份上我一直忍着。

lines.en: And yes, I can be nice like this every once in a while if I actually apply myself.
lines.zh: 没错，只要我真的上心，偶尔也是能这么体贴的。

lines.en: : Sensei! Did you see my sweet dropkick earlier? I almost landed a hit on the instructor!
lines.zh: : Sensei！你看到我刚才那记帅气的飞踢了吗？我差点就踢中教练了！

lines.en: : Yes. And I also saw you get scolded shortly after for using a pro-wrestling style dropkick in karate class.
lines.zh: : 看到了。我也看到你紧接着就因为在空手道课上用职业摔角的飞踢而被骂了。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo2
: Hey, if it works, it works.
lines.zh: : 嘿，只要管用就行嘛。

lines.en: : It didn’t work, though.
lines.zh: : 可你根本没管用啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, but neither does normal karate so I was trying to improvise.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可普通的空手道也不管用，所以我就想着临场发挥一下。

lines.en: : It's not my fault Miss Osaka is some kind of martial arts goddess.
lines.zh: : Osaka 老师简直是武术女神，这可不是我的错。

lines.en: : I didn’t say that was your fault. I’m just saying you might want to start using, you know, {i}karate{/i} moves if you ever plan on getting better at karate.
lines.zh: : 我没说那是你的错。我只是说，如果你真打算把空手道练好，也许该开始用，你知道的，{i}空手道{/i}的招式。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo3
: Guh. Maybe we should just take up pro-wrestling instead? Especially with all of those rumors floating around about the place being sold and stuff.
lines.zh: : 呃。要不我们干脆改练职业摔角算了？尤其是现在到处都在传这个地方要被卖掉什么的。

lines.en: : Those are {i}still{/i} going around?
lines.zh: : 那些传言{i}还在{/i}传？

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo4
: They haven’t even slowed down.
lines.zh: : 一点都没消停过。

lines.en: : I tried asking Miss Osaka about it the other day and even she wasn’t sure what was going on.
lines.zh: : 前几天我试着问过 Osaka 老师，连她自己都不清楚情况。

lines.en: : She doesn’t even know if she’ll be allowed to keep her job, so I told her I’d ask my dad about hiring her as my personal instructor if things really came to that.
lines.zh: : 她连自己能不能保住这份工作都不知道，所以我跟她说，万一真到那一步，我会去问我爸，看能不能请她当我的私人教练。

lines.en: : Is this really what you want to keep on doing? You're not going to, like...move on or something?
lines.zh: : 你真的想一直练下去吗？你就没想过……往前走，或者别的什么？

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo1
: Do you remember the first time you showed up here, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你还记得你第一次来这儿的时候吗？

lines.en: : I am reminded every time the instructor makes fun of me for not paying my own membership.
lines.zh: : 每次教练拿我没自己交会费这件事嘲笑我的时候，我都会想起来。

lines.en: : There's no shame in having a sugar mama, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 有个富婆包养你又不丢人，Sensei。

lines.en: : Yes there is and please don't call yourself that.
lines.zh: : 就是丢人，而且请别这么称呼你自己。

lines.en: : Anyway, it might sound a little silly...but I think it may have been fate that led you here.
lines.zh: : 总之，这话听起来可能有点傻……但我觉得，是命运把你带到了这里。

lines.en: : So unless there’s some sign that descends from up above telling me that I should stop doing karate, I’m going to keep going.
lines.zh: : 所以除非有什么征兆从天而降，告诉我该停止练空手道了，否则我会一直练下去。

lines.en: : Besides, even if I’m using American wrestling moves, I’ve definitely been feeling way better physically lately.
lines.zh: : 再说了，就算我用的是美式摔角的招式，最近身体确实明显好多了。

lines.en: : My body’s actually in such good shape that pretty soon, I might be able to pull off some super crazy sex moves.
lines.zh: : 我的身体状态好到，说不定再过不久，我就能做出一些超级疯狂的性爱动作了。

lines.en: : I’m quite interested in finding out what sort of {i}super crazy sex moves{/i} derive from amateur karate lessons.
lines.zh: : 我倒是挺想知道，业余空手道课能衍生出什么样的{i}超级疯狂的性爱动作{/i}。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo5
: They’d probably be easier for you to understand if you actually practiced every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 你要是偶尔真的练一练，大概会更容易理解它们。

lines.en: : What do you think I was doing today? I very clearly practiced.
lines.zh: : 你以为我今天在干嘛？我明明练了啊。

lines.en: : For three minutes, sure. After that, you just sat around and stared at all of the other girls’ butts.
lines.zh: : 练了三分钟，没错。之后你就坐在那儿，盯着其他所有女孩的屁股看。

lines.en: : I was practicing my observational skills- one of the key fundamentals of karate.
lines.zh: : 我那是在练习观察力——空手道的基本功之一。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo6
: Well observe {i}me{/i} more next time instead of everybody else or I’ll be forced to become a martial arts master and eliminate all of them.
lines.zh: : 那下次多观察{i}我{/i}，别看别人，不然我就只好成为武术大师，把她们全灭了。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo7
: Pardon me, you two, but would either of you be willing to spare a moment of your time?
lines.zh: : 打扰一下，二位，不知能否占用你们一点时间？

lines.en: : I’d like to ask you a few questions about this establishment, if you don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 如果你们不介意的话，我想问几个关于这家道场的问题。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo8
: Hm? Who’s that?
lines.zh: : 嗯？那是谁？

lines.en: : No clue. She looks really...elegant, though.
lines.zh: : 不知道。不过她看起来真的很……优雅。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo9
: And I don’t?!
lines.zh: : 那我就不优雅吗？！

lines.en: : Not really. Her rich-girl aura is much stronger than yours. Especially considering you’re wearing a karate uniform.
lines.zh: : 不太优雅。她那股富家千金的气场比你强多了。尤其是你现在还穿着空手道服。

lines.en: : It’s called a {i}Karategi{/i}, Sensei! Pay attention in class!
lines.zh: : 那叫{i}空手道服{/i}，Sensei！上课专心点！

lines.en: : But there are just so many butts to look at.
lines.zh: : 可是有那么多屁股可以看嘛。

lines.en: : Umm...hello? Can you not see me?
lines.zh: : 嗯……打扰一下？你们是看不见我吗？

lines.en: : Is there some sort of...karate code barring you from speaking with people dressed in normal attire?
lines.zh: : 难道有什么……空手道的规矩，禁止你们和穿着便服的人说话？

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo10
: Oh, no. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦，不是。抱歉。

lines.en: : You can come talk to us as long as you promise not to steal this man away from me.
lines.zh: : 你可以过来跟我们说话，只要你保证不把这个男人从我身边抢走。

lines.en: : I have no intention of that whatsoever. He seems rather brutish in nature.
lines.zh: : 我完全没有那个打算。他看起来粗野得很。

lines.en: : You know, maybe it would be better if you two just spoke in private. I’m clearly not needed here.
lines.zh: : 那个，也许你们两个单独聊会更好。显然这儿用不着我。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo11
: Oh, stop. You know I need you every minute of every day...Every day of every year. Every-
lines.zh: : 哦，别这么说。你知道我每一天、每一分钟都需要你……每一年、每一天。每一——

lines.en: : Every year of every decade.
lines.zh: : 每十年里的每一年。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo12
: Oh, sincerest apologies. I thought we were playing a game.
lines.zh: : 哦，万分抱歉。我还以为我们在玩什么游戏呢。

lines.en: : You’ll need to forgive me. I don’t typically converse with the middle class and may say some things that are quite hard for people of your kind to understand.
lines.zh: : 请你原谅。我平时不怎么和中产阶级交谈，所以可能会说一些你们这类人很难理解的话。

lines.en: : Middle class? But I’m not middle class at all.
lines.zh: : 中产阶级？我可根本不是什么中产阶级。

lines.en: : I have the second largest house in Kumon-mi. We even have a room that's literally just a giant ball pit.
lines.zh: : 我家是 Kumon-mi 第二大的房子。我们甚至有一间屋子，整个就是个巨型球池。

lines.en: : What? Since when?
lines.zh: : 什么？什么时候的事？

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo13
: The second largest...
lines.zh: : 第二大的……

lines.en: : Then that must mean-
lines.zh: : 那岂不是意味着——

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo14
: You wouldn’t happen to be Ayane Amamiya, would you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会就是 Ayane Amamiya 吧？

lines.en: : That's my name!
lines.zh: : 正是本人！

lines.en: : But...who are you exactly? You've yet to introduce yourself.
lines.zh: : 不过……你到底是谁？你还没自我介绍呢。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo15
: Oh my, where are my manners?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，我真是失礼了。

lines.en: : My name is Touka Tsukioka- daughter of Tomonori Tsukioka and planned heir of the Tsukioka Foundation. It’s wonderful to finally meet you.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Touka Tsukioka，是 Tomonori Tsukioka 的女儿，也是 Tsukioka 财团的预定继承人。终于见到你了，真是荣幸。

lines.en: : Nice to meet you too! Judging by your clothes, I’m guessing you’ve got an even bigger ball pit than I do.
lines.zh: : 我也很高兴认识你！看你的穿着，我猜你家的球池比我家还大吧。

lines.en: : Ball...pit?
: It's like a swimming pool full of plastic balls.
lines.zh: : 就像是一个装满塑料球的游泳池。

lines.en: : How wonderfully creative. My family prefers to fill our pools with water. It had not occurred to me until today that there were other options available.
lines.zh: : 真是别出心裁。我们家的池子更喜欢灌水。直到今天我才想到，原来还有别的选择。

lines.en: : You don't get out much, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不太出门吧？

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo16
: And you are? A butler perhaps?
lines.zh: : 那你是？管家之类的？

lines.en: : Oh, that’s my teacher. And future husband.
lines.zh: : 哦，那是我的老师。也是我未来的丈夫。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo17
: I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : He's my future husband, I said. We're going to get married and have a disturbing amount of children one day.
lines.zh: : 我说的是我未来的丈夫。我们总有一天会结婚，然后生一大堆多得吓人的孩子。

lines.en: : Future husband? This man?
lines.zh: : 未来的丈夫？这个人？

lines.en: : You’ll have to forgive me if this is some sort of joke I’m not picking up on, but he seems rather...unfitting. Don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 如果这是什么我没听懂的玩笑，那我先道个歉，不过他看起来实在……不太相配。你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : That's fair. But also kind of rude.
lines.zh: : 说得倒也没错。不过也有点失礼。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo18
: Woah- hold on a second. I don’t care {i}how{/i} rich you are, no one talks down to Sensei in front of me. And {i}definitely{/i} no one questions whether he and I are meant to be together.
lines.zh: : 哇——等一下。不管你{i}有{/i}多有钱，都没人能在我面前贬低 Sensei。而且{i}绝对{/i}没人能质疑我和他是不是天生一对。

lines.en: I can think of at least eleven other girls who question that off the top of my head.
lines.zh: 我随口一想，就能数出至少十一个对此表示质疑的女孩。

lines.en: : Oh dear, I’m terribly sorry. I didn’t mean to offend.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，实在抱歉。我并无冒犯之意。

lines.en: : I just assumed you’d be getting married to someone of slightly higher status to propel your family’s name forward.
lines.zh: : 我只是以为，你会嫁给一个地位稍高一些的人，好把你们家的名声往前推一推。

lines.en: : But, perhaps...that’s just the way my family handles things? If so, I humbly ask for forgiveness.
lines.zh: : 不过，也许……那只是我们家的处事方式？如果是这样，我恳请你原谅。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo19
: Uhh...it’s fine, just...
lines.zh: : 呃……没关系，只是……

lines.en: : What’s up? Why did you need to talk to us?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你找我们有什么事？

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo20
: Oh, yes. I was actually just looking to speak with some of the common folk who use this dojo about their feelings for it.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。其实我只是想找几个使用这家道场的普通人，聊聊他们对这里的感情。

lines.en: : You see, I’ve recently taken an interest in martial arts and have been looking into acquiring an establishment like this one for my own personal use.
lines.zh: : 是这样的，我最近对武术产生了兴趣，正在考虑收购一家像这样的场所，供我个人使用。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo21
: Of course, it’s overwhelmingly clear that a large amount of work must be done in order to bring it up to my family's standards-
lines.zh: : 当然，很明显，要把它提升到我们家的标准，还得花上大量的功夫——

lines.en: : So hearing about the condition of the building from people who are here regularly would provide some much-needed peace of mind.
lines.zh: : 所以，听听常来这里的人说说这栋建筑的状况，能让我安心不少。

lines.en: : Wait...hold on...{i}You’re{/i} the one who’s planning on buying this place out?
lines.zh: : 等等……等一下……打算把这里买下来的人是{i}你{/i}？

lines.en: : I don't mean to brag, but I kind of saw that one coming.
lines.zh: : 我可不是自夸，不过我早就隐约料到了。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo22
: I didn’t! I thought she was just here to try out the class or something!
lines.zh: : 我可没料到！我还以为她只是来试课的什么的！

lines.en: : Oh, heavens no. I could never practice in a place like this given its current state. Especially not alongside people like this commoner here.
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪，当然不是。以它现在的状况，我绝不可能在这种地方练习。更别提和这位平民之类的人一起练了。

lines.en: : I’m sure you understand that I mean no offense by that, yes?
lines.zh: : 我这么说绝无冒犯之意，你明白的吧？

lines.en: : I think you could probably use a little more practice when it comes to {i}not{/i} offending people.
lines.zh: : 我觉得在{i}不{/i}得罪人这件事上，你大概还得多练练。

lines.en: : You’re not wrong, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你说得没错。

lines.en: : I seldom am.
lines.zh: : 我很少出错。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo23
: With all due respect, Touka...this place really means a lot to me and everyone else here.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，Touka……这个地方对我、对这儿的所有人都意义重大。

lines.en: : Having this dojo taken from us would leave pretty much nowhere else to practice.
lines.zh: : 要是这座道场被夺走，我们基本上就再也没有别的地方可以练了。

lines.en: : I’m sure there is a...parking lot or vacant warehouse somewhere in the city that you can use if you truly want, correct?
lines.zh: : 我相信城里总该有……某个停车场或者空仓库，你真想要的话可以用，对吧？

lines.en: : Doesn’t the same go for you? Do you even know karate?
lines.zh: : 你不也一样吗？你到底会不会空手道？

lines.en: : Not yet, but my father is insistent on hiring the greatest instructor in Kumon-mi to tutor me directly.
lines.zh: : 现在还不会，不过我父亲执意要请 Kumon-mi 最好的教练来亲自教我。

lines.en: : You know how fathers can be. Only the best for their daughters and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，做父亲的都那样。女儿要什么就得给最好的，之类的。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo24
: Only...the best for...
lines.zh: : 女儿要什么……就得给最好的……

lines.en: : Miss Amamiya?...Did I say something wrong?
lines.zh: : Amamiya 小姐？……我是不是说错什么了？

lines.en: : Is it because you don’t think you’ll be able to practice here anymore?
lines.zh: : 是不是因为你觉得以后没法在这里练了？

lines.en: : If it truly upsets you, I may be able to convince my father to let you train alongside me given our respective statuses in the city.
lines.zh: : 如果这真的让你难过，鉴于我们两家在这座城市各自的地位，我也许能说服父亲让你陪我一起练。

lines.en: : Though...I unfortunately can not guarantee that the others will be able to join us as well.
lines.zh: : 不过……遗憾的是，我无法保证其他人也能一起。

lines.en: : I’m sure you understand.
lines.zh: : 我想你能理解的。

lines.en: : Not really...
lines.zh: : 不太理解……

lines.en: : And I’m kind of starting to lose hope now, so...
lines.zh: : 而且我现在有点开始绝望了，所以……

lines.en: : I think I’m going to go for a walk.
lines.zh: : 我想我要出去走走。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo25
: Don’t...follow me, okay? I’ve gotta try and figure some stuff out...
lines.zh: : 别……跟着我，好吗？我得试着把一些事情想清楚……

lines.en: : I’ll call you later.
lines.zh: : 我晚点打给你。

lines.en: : Uhh...sure. Okay.
lines.zh: : 呃……好。行吧。

lines.en: : See you later, then.
lines.zh: : 那回头见。

lines.en: : Miss Amamiya, I-
lines.zh: : Amamiya 小姐，我——

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo26
Ayane walks out of the dojo without even changing back into her normal clothes and suddenly I’m alone with a girl who has likely never been this close to someone as “middle-class” as me.
lines.zh: Ayane 连平常的衣服都没换回来就走出了道场，转眼间，我就和一个大概从未如此近距离接触过像我这么「中产阶级」的人的女孩单独待在了一起。

lines.en: : Oh dear...
lines.zh: : 哎呀……

lines.en: : I had no idea that these circumstances would affect her so dramatically.
lines.zh: : 我完全没想到，这些情况会让她受到这么大的打击。

lines.en: : You didn’t think that buying out the place she comes to every weekend would upset her?
lines.zh: : 你没想过，把她每个周末都来的地方买下来，会让她难过吗？

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo27
: I did not know she came here in general.
lines.zh: : 我根本不知道她会来这种地方。

lines.en: : Miss Amamiya’s family is not one I know on a personal level, but I’ve heard my father speak of them on numerous occasions.
lines.zh: : Amamiya 小姐的家，我私下里并不熟悉，但我听我父亲提起过他们很多次。

lines.en: : Never in a million years did I think she’d be spending time somewhere so...{i}this{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我做梦也没想到，她会把时间花在这么……{i}这种{/i}地方。

lines.en: : Perhaps her wealth is not as great as I’d been led to believe...
lines.zh: : 也许她家的财富并不像别人让我以为的那么可观……

lines.en: : I think it’s more along the lines of Ayane wanting to feel like a normal girl. She definitely has money.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更多的原因是 Ayane 想让自己像个普通女孩。她家绝对有钱。

lines.en: : I was at her house just recently and can testify that it was pretty remarkable.
lines.zh: : 我最近才去过她家，可以作证，那房子相当了得。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo28
: They let you in?
lines.zh: : 他们让你进去了？

lines.en: : ...Yes. They let me in.
lines.zh: : ……对。他们让我进去了。

lines.en: : Wow. It’s just one surprise after another today.
lines.zh: : 哇。今天真是一个接一个的惊喜。

lines.en: : Ayane was right. You don’t really get out much, do you?
lines.zh: : Ayane 说得对。你真的不太出门吧？

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo29
: I actually go horseback riding rather frequently. And I’m part of a women’s golf organization as well.
lines.zh: : 其实我常去骑马。而且我还参加了一个女子高尔夫社团。

lines.en: : You’re just a walking rich-girl stereotype, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你简直就是个活生生的富家千金刻板印象，对吧？

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo30
: Hahah! I suppose I am!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！我想是的！

lines.en: scene black
Touka gets off the ground (Which I’m sure was a real pain to sit on for someone of her status) and exits the dojo minutes later.
lines.zh: Touka 从地上站起身（我敢肯定，对她那种身份的人来说，坐在地上一定相当难受），几分钟后走出了道场。

lines.en: With Ayane still nowhere to be found, I make my way over to the instructor to figure out whether or not she knows anything...
lines.zh: Ayane 仍然不见踪影，于是我走向教练，想弄清楚她是否知道些什么……

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo31
: What now? Don’t you give me enough problems already?
lines.zh: : 又怎么了？你给我惹的麻烦还不够多吗？

lines.en: : No. I’m here to give you one more.
lines.zh: : 不。我是来再给你添一个的。

lines.en: : Of course you are. What do you need?
lines.zh: : 你当然就是来添麻烦的。你要什么？

lines.en: : Is this about the rich girl who just waltzed in here like she owned the place?
lines.zh: : 是关于刚才那个大摇大摆走进来、好像这地方是她家的一样有钱小姐吗？

lines.en: : I mean...{i}isn’t she{/i} actually about to own the place, though?
lines.zh: : 我是说……她{i}不就{/i}真的快要成为这里的主人了吗？

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo32
: Beats me. I'm more worried about keeping my job than anything else.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。比起别的，我更担心能不能保住工作。

lines.en: : It's not like any of you take this seriously anyway. Why does it matter if someone else buys the place out?
lines.zh: : 反正你们也没一个把这当回事。别人把这里买下来又有什么关系？

lines.en: : Ayane takes it seriously.
lines.zh: : Ayane 是认真的。

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo33
: Then she should stop bringing guns in. We’re lucky she hasn’t gotten us closed down to begin with.
lines.zh: : 那她就别再把枪带进来了。我们没被勒令关门就已经算走运了。

lines.en: : I can't believe I'm asking this...but is there anything we can do?
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信自己会问这个……不过，我们有什么能做的吗？

lines.en: scene ayanetoukadojo34
: If you’re really that worried, which I’m sure you aren’t considering you’ve spent maybe less than an hour actually doing anything since you signed up, why not talk to Ayane first?
lines.zh: : 如果你真有那么担心——不过我肯定你没有，毕竟你报名以来真正干过事的时间恐怕还不到一小时——那为什么不先去跟 Ayane 谈谈？

lines.en: : I talk to Ayane all the time.
lines.zh: : 我一直都在跟 Ayane 说话啊。

lines.en: : Not like that, you fucking idiot.
lines.zh: : 不是那种说话，你这个蠢货。

lines.en: : Ayane's crazy rich too, isn’t she? Maybe their families can start some sort of bidding war or something?
lines.zh: : Ayane 家也富得离谱吧？也许她们两家能打一场竞标战什么的？

lines.en: : Maybe?...She didn’t seem to think her dad would be into the idea, though.
lines.zh: : 也许吧？……不过她似乎觉得她爸不会赞成这个主意。

lines.en: : Don’t know until you try, right?
lines.zh: : 不试试怎么知道，对吧？

lines.en: : It's not really my place to interfere. I'm just hoping this Tsukioka girl isn’t a pain in the ass.
lines.zh: : 这毕竟不是我该插手的事。我只希望这个 Tsukioka 家的姑娘别太难缠。

lines.en: : Because based on first impressions alone, she really comes off as that “Don’t hit me” type and girls like that are the actual worst to teach.
lines.zh: : 因为光看第一印象，她就是那种「别打我」的类型，而那种女孩是最难教的。

lines.en: : Especially when their fathers step in and prevent you from doing things how you know they need to be done.
lines.zh: : 尤其是当她们的父亲插手，不让你按你知道该有的方式去教的时候。

lines.en: : Really lucked out with Ayane not being like that, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 现在想想，Ayane 不是那种人，我还真是走了运。

lines.en: : I guess she is kind of a good girl...even if she’s broken literally every single rule I set.
lines.zh: : 我想她算是个好姑娘吧……尽管我定的每一条规矩她都真真切切地违反了个遍。

lines.en: : Well, no matter what happens to the dojo, I hope things work out for you.
lines.zh: : 那么，不管这座道场最后怎样，我都希望你能一切顺利。

lines.en: : What? No you don't. You have never expressed an ounce of concern for me in my life.
lines.zh: : 什么？你才不会。你这辈子对我表达过哪怕一丁点关心吗。

lines.en: : Then I will start right now.
lines.zh: : 那我就从现在开始。

lines.en: : Cool. Start by practicing.
lines.zh: : 好啊。那就从练习开始。

lines.en: scene black
: On second thought, it's getting late and I should probably start heading home.
lines.zh: : 再想想，天色已晚，我大概该回家了。

lines.en: : Yeah, that's exactly what I thought...
lines.zh: : 是啊，我就知道你会这么说……

lines.en: Obviously, I don't intend to actually go home. But as I exit the dojo, I {i}am{/i} hoping to find Ayane sulking on the steps or something.
lines.zh: 显然，我并不打算真的回家。但当我走出道场时，我{i}确实{/i}希望能看到 Ayane 闷闷不乐地坐在台阶上什么的。

lines.en: Of course, she’s nowhere to be found- so I take a few laps around the block in an attempt to bump into her before giving up on it entirely and deciding to just...do something else for the rest of the day.
lines.zh: 当然，她哪儿都不在——于是我绕着街区走了几圈，想碰碰运气遇上她，最后彻底放弃，决定接下来这一天……干脆做点别的事。

lines.en: She'll call me if she needs me.
lines.zh: 她需要我的时候会打电话给我的。

lines.en: Maybe.
lines.zh: 也许吧。

lines.en: $ ayane_love += 1
$ dojo30 = True
{i}Ayane’s affection has increased to [ayane_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
